sourceNotes.rawContent:
Fashioned in a chic rose-gold tone, this V-shaped minimalist ring is accentuated with sparkling cubic zirconia stones along the band. The sleek curve adds a modern flair and looks beautiful worn alone or stacked with other rings.
- Material: Alloy base
- Plating: Rose gold plated
- Stone Type: Cubic zirconia stones
- Design: V-shaped crystal band ring
- Size / Fit: Free size – adjustable
- Best Suitable For: Everyday wear, party wear, gift for women
